note: Guatemala: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90 days, extendable by 90 (CA-4 citizens on an identity card); everyone else needs a visa (holders of a Schengen, Canadian, Mexican or US visa or a US green card may enter: not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Institute's Reglamento de Visas (AMN-04-2025), which sets the categories A (exempt), B (consular visa) and C (consulted visa) but leaves the country list to the Foreign Ministry's table, which refused this client, so the list stands on Wikipedia's copy. Its Article 10 (US, Mexican, Canadian or Schengen visa holders treated as exempt) isn't modelled.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Guatemala
sources.said: Citizens of the following countries and territories may enter Guatemala without a visa for up to 90 days. The stay may be extended for an additional 90 days.
